propositions: Plan-review attestations must record signed material fingerprints of direct child and prerequisite tickets at review time to detect downstream drift
Execution-phase reviews enforce a fixed 0.80 priority floor via blocking-threshold resolution and require compatible phase/floor in the signed manifest for close gates
Prerequisite consistency is evaluated deterministically and in isolation, yielding one three-disposition record per prerequisite with attribution metadata and unsigned fallback on indeterminate
Pre-sign collection re-verifies all relationship membership and fingerprints under the global write lock; concurrent changes abort the review before signing

Plan-review-phase is a reducer-maintained projection that survives snapshot compaction and updates only from the winning process_status branch: entry to in_progress sets execution, entry to open resets planning

Disabled pin enforcement reports drift advisory without invalidating attestations; enabled enforcement invalidates named consumers after related material drift and blocks close only when both close-review and pin-enforcement flags are active
